headline_seed: US Supreme Court asked to restore abortion pill access
description_seed: A lower court has limited mail-order access to the abortion pill mifepristone, which the drug's maker says will cause "irreparable harm".

what: US Supreme Court asked to restore abortion pill access

clean_source_blocks.text: A lower court has limited mail-order access to the abortion pill mifepristone, which the drug's maker says will cause "irreparable harm".
The pharmaceutical company that makes the abortion pill mifepristone has asked the Supreme Court to intervene after a lower court placed significant restrictions on access to the pill by mail.
On Saturday, Danco Laboratories, the pharmaceutical company that makes mifepristone, asked the Supreme Court to intervene and pause the ruling, temporarily restoring access to the pill.
In 2024, the US Supreme Court unanimously rejected an effort to restrict access to mifepristone.

source_text:
A lower court has limited mail-order access to the abortion pill mifepristone, which the drug's maker says will cause "irreparable harm".

The pharmaceutical company that makes the abortion pill mifepristone has asked the Supreme Court to intervene after a lower court placed significant restrictions on access to the pill by mail.

On Saturday, Danco Laboratories, the pharmaceutical company that makes mifepristone, asked the Supreme Court to intervene and pause the ruling, temporarily restoring access to the pill.

In 2024, the US Supreme Court unanimously rejected an effort to restrict access to mifepristone.
